verdicts.reason: Both break the design apart. The decorative frames, peach panel and pasta pattern are scattered as empty boxes and a floating tile. Both pasta photos shrink to thumbnail size. The orange divider strokes and the plate sketch are strung across the top like debris. A puts the 'Cascadia' / RESTAURANT / URL lockup on a clean baseline beside a big headline. B ties the orange divider to the headline, but it floats 'RESTAURANT' above and to the right of 'Cascadia' (wrong reading order, misaligned), and its photos are even smaller, so A is marginally less bad.
